Context: Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana Vedavyāsa, traditional author of the Mahābhārata (and its gītās), the purāṇas, the Vyāsasmṛti; also the Vyāsa of the Yogabhāṣya, whom tradition identifies with him though Pandit keeps a separate record (85147)
Note: Kept d0644 together: several readers made one Vyāsa the author of both the epics and the Yogabhāṣya, so the Yogabhāṣyakāra (p1-catalogue-004:p20) cannot be cleanly separated; whether he should be is a judgement call.
